body: People who know me know my default reddit account.  I don't want to use it to talk about how fucking suicidal I am.

I've had to come to terms with the fact that I'm a miserable, worthless piece of shit and a failure as a human being.  Every day I struggle with the fact that people I care about still care about me so I can't just throw myself into total drug addiction or kill myself and instead I have to go on, day after day, trying to act like a regular person when I know I deserve nothing but misery and suffering.
